fillBadges.mask: Emits an instance mask with every detection: the Segmentation step can take its masks from this model instead of running its own.
fillBadges.cropFace: Draws face boxes inside people: face detection can refine them for recognition (from a 640 px or larger model input), once "Use the root model" is checked on that step.
fillBadges.cropPlate: Draws plate boxes inside vehicles: plate detection can use them, and the plate reader reads them, once "Use the root model" is checked on that step.
fillBadges.labelsDefaultUncovered: {{stepId}} takes this model's labels by default — its own model does not run; this model cannot produce {{uncovered}}.
fillBadges.labelsDefaultAll: {{stepId}} takes this model's labels by default — its own model does not run, for every class.
fillBadges.labelsOptionalUncovered: {{stepId}} can take this model's labels; this model cannot produce {{uncovered}}.
fillBadges.labelsOptionalAll: {{stepId}} can take this model's labels, for every class.
